# --opt test=true is accepted by both generate and build (emission deferred).

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out --opt test=true app.sngl
exists out/index.html

[!exec:go] skip 'go toolchain required'
sngl build --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --opt test=true --opt name=tapp bt.sngl
exists tapp

-- app.sngl --
component main {
    text(value="hi")
}
-- bt.sngl --
output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    text(value="hi")
}
